one_line: Global AI developments feature data centre infrastructure expansions, evolving regulatory scrutiny over AI agents, and workforce impacts across industries.

themes.title: Data centre investments and infrastructure plans grow
themes.text: Japan's JERA is in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres near Tokyo, while Bharti Airtel plans three data centres in Assam, and developers continue exploring vertical designs amid land limits.

stories.headline: Japan's JERA enters talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres
Developers propose vertical data centers as Kansas City blocks high-rise plan
Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres

themes.title: UK regulator addresses Meta personal AI agent
themes.text: Following Meta's launch of its Muse personal AI agent in the UK, the Competition and Markets Authority issued warnings on user control, prompting Meta to update its terms of service.

stories.headline: UK regulator warns AI agents must provide user control as Meta Muse launches
Meta changes UK Muse terms of service to reflect consumer law

themes.title: Reports and restructuring highlight workforce impacts
themes.text: A JP Morgan report estimates AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs over five years, while Swiggy Instamart cuts 340 jobs amid increased AI adoption and restructuring.

stories.headline: AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in five years: JP Morgan
Swiggy Instamart lays off 340 employees amid AI push and inventory shift
